# Walk cost budget: # The test fails when a measurement exceeds recorded * limit. For time_ratio
# the limit is the ceiling itself and recorded is what was observed.
# For alloc_mb and size_mb it also fails BELOW recorded * (2 - limit): the
# walk became cheaper and the recorded value has to come down with it
# the gain cannot be given back unnoticed. Time has no floor; it is noisy.
# RAISING A VALUE NEEDS THE MAINTAINER'S APPROVAL. A failure here means the
# walk now costs more; the first response is to find what made it so
# move the number. When the extra cost is accepted
# the value says what it buys. Lowering a value after an improvement locks
# the gain in and needs no approval.
